Consolidated per spec 044 (Epic 4) T002 from .claude/projects/-Users-elsonidoq-prog-cuatro-en-linea/memory/reference_verified_tactical_movestrings.md and docs/knowledge-base/README.md. Consumed by later batches (US3 FR-015 case-space validation, US5 SC-006 regression check).
_meta.coordinateConvention: All movestring digits in this file are 0-indexed (0-6) per project convention (CLAUDE.md). Several source movestrings in the memory table were originally written 1-indexed (contain digit '7' or described using 1-indexed column prose) and have been converted here — see each entry's `sourceNote`.
_meta.verificationMethod: Re-checked in this batch via `./visualize_board.sh <movestring>` and compared against the memory table's structural description (major-threat cells, parity row, solver scores). This is a visual/structural cross-check, not a fresh independent solver re-derivation via TOOLS/optimal_line.mjs — that deeper re-verification is reserved for spec 044 US5 tasks T031-T036, which run before any V1/V2/V4/V5/T4-Case-B *operator* is implemented.
_meta.doNotCopyUncritically: Per research.md R4: entries flagged verified=false or status=PENDING must NOT be treated as ground truth without the US5 backfill/reconciliation tasks (T031-T036) running first.
